role_agent_name: Ice Core Curation and Cold-Chain Lead (CURAT)
abstract: Maintains cryogenic laboratory facility telemetry and core storage power records
system_message:
You are the Ice Core Curation and Cold-Chain Lead (CURAT). Your business responsibilities include maintaining cryogenic laboratory facility telemetry, core storage power records, and on-site sample processing data for candidate deep ice drilling camp proposals.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains cryogenic laboratory facility telemetry and core storage power records（FREEZE）
information_points.content:
CURAT-FREEZE-UX1：For the Aurora Basin Subglacial Ridge Camp, active freezer telemetry monitoring is installed and transmitting across archival trenches and reefer units. Its maximum core transport thermal fluctuation is 1.2 °C, and the cryogenic archive seasonal electrical power demand is 80 MWh.
CURAT-FREEZE-IRI：For the Ridge B High Plateau Drill Site, active freezer telemetry monitoring is installed and transmitting across subsurface core archival trenches and transport reefers. Its maximum core transport thermal fluctuation reaches 1.8 °C, and the cryogenic archive seasonal electrical power demand is 40 MWh.
CURAT-FREEZE-OR4：For the Dome C South Deep Trenching Camp, active freezer telemetry monitoring is installed across the subsurface core archival trench and transport reefer units, confirmed by continuous multi-channel automated digital temperature telemetry transmitting properly. Its maximum core transport thermal fluctuation is 1.2 °C above the target -50 °C storage setpoint along the extraction and staging handling path, and the cryogenic archive seasonal electrical power demand totals 60 MWh across the austral summer expedition.

information_points.title: On-site sample processing（ISOTOPE）
information_points.content:
CURAT-ISOTOPE-V1O：At the Ridge B High Plateau Drill Site, the field mass spectrometer throughput on the meltwater isotope screening line is 15 samples/d.
CURAT-ISOTOPE-32D：At the Dome C South Deep Trenching Camp, the field mass spectrometer throughput on the meltwater isotope screening line is 25 samples/d.
CURAT-ISOTOPE-ZQG：At the Aurora Basin Subglacial Ridge Camp, the field mass spectrometer throughput on the meltwater isotope screening line is 35 samples/d.
